notes.title: Team based game modes are now LIVE!
notes.content:
Added 3 new Team based game modes:
[list]
[*] [b]Team Deathmatch[/b]: The deathmatch you know and love - now with the power of friendship! Pulverize the competition with your pal’s unconditional support (and a hail of bullets).

[*] [b]Plant / Defuse the Bomb[/b]: In this totally original game mode, two teams take turns planting a bomb in the opponent’s zone, and then making sure said explosive goes kaboom. Be careful though - the planter can’t defend themselves while in the act, and the teams switch sides after 4 rounds. First to 5 successful kablooies wins!

[*] [b]Knockback Soccer[/b]: The world’s game, made better. Compete in teams of two or more, using your bullets instead of your feet to score. And no, you can’t kill your opponents - not directly, anyway.
[/list]

What are you waiting for? Jump in, have fun and Knock yourself out!
